title: The Math of Dating: Who Should Move First? | Game Theory #1
title_alternatives: Game Theory #1: Why Dating Apps Feel Like a Casino
The Side That Waits Always Loses? The Math of Dating
description:
Every night, millions of people play a game nobody ever explained to them: the dating game. In 1962, two mathematicians worked out its rules, and what they found has a twist.

Who should make the first move: you, or the one who waits? Why does a dating app feel like a casino? And when should you stop searching? Game theory has answers.

TEAM "make the first move" or TEAM "wait and see"? Fight it out in the comments.

10:43 When to stop searching (the 37% rule)
11:36 How to win the dating game

SOURCES

- Nobel Prize in Economics 2012: Alvin Roth and Lloyd Shapley

- B. F. Skinner, schedules of reinforcement, 1950s
